headline: ACC summons former army chief Shafiuddin Ahmed over corruption
summary: The Anti-Corruption Commission has asked the retired general to appear for questioning regarding allegations of illegally amassing wealth.
details: The Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) has summoned former army chief of staff Gen (retd) SM Shafiuddin Ahmed for questioning.
The summons is related to allegations of amassing wealth illegally through corruption and irregularities during his tenure.
Shafiuddin has been asked to appear before the commission on September 14, bringing a photocopy of his national identity (NID) card.
ACC Director and inquiry team leader Abul Hasnat stated that recording his statement is essential to ensure a proper inquiry into the allegations.
A two-member inquiry team has been formed to investigate the matter, consisting of Abul Hasnat and Deputy Director Mozammel Hossain.
caption:
Former army chief Gen (retd) SM Shafiuddin Ahmed has been summoned by the ACC over illegal wealth allegations.

The Anti-Corruption Commission (ACC) has summoned former army chief of staff Gen (retd) SM Shafiuddin Ahmed for questioning.

The summons is related to allegations of amassing wealth illegally through corruption and irregularities during his tenure.

Shafiuddin has been asked to appear before the commission on September 14, bringing a photocopy of his national identity (NID) card.

ACC Director and inquiry team leader Abul Hasnat stated that recording his statement is essential to ensure a proper inquiry into the allegations.

A two-member inquiry team has been formed to investigate the matter, consisting of Abul Hasnat and Deputy Director Mozammel Hossain.

headline_marked: New lead in Sagar-Runi case: [[Cultural personality linked to murder]]
headline: New lead in Sagar-Runi case: Cultural personality linked to murder
summary: Chief Prosecutor of the International Crimes Tribunal claims evidence from call records points to a prominent cultural figure's involvement in the 14-year-old cold case.
details: Chief Prosecutor of the International Crimes Tribunal, Md. Aminul Islam, has claimed that a 'cultural personality' is linked to the murder of journalist couple Sagar Sarwar and Meherun Runi.
The lead emerged while reviewing Call Detail Records (CDR) during the investigation of another separate case.
The prosecutor shared this information with journalists at his office on Sunday, though he did not disclose the identity of the individual.
Sagar Sarwar and Meherun Runi were killed 14 years ago in a case that has remained one of the most high-profile unsolved murders in Bangladesh's journalistic community.
caption:
A 14-year-old cold case gets a shocking new lead. A 'cultural personality' is now linked to the Sagar-Runi murders.

Chief Prosecutor of the International Crimes Tribunal, Md. Aminul Islam, has claimed that a 'cultural personality' is linked to the murder of journalist couple Sagar Sarwar and Meherun Runi.

The lead emerged while reviewing Call Detail Records (CDR) during the investigation of another separate case.

The prosecutor shared this information with journalists at his office on Sunday, though he did not disclose the identity of the individual.

Sagar Sarwar and Meherun Runi were killed 14 years ago in a case that has remained one of the most high-profile unsolved murders in Bangladesh's journalistic community.
